thread:
dario: Quick heads-up — we just finished the canary for the new prefix-dedup cache and the numbers look solid :tada:

sahana: Nice! summary stats?

dario: p50 latency down ~11%, p95 down ~18%, p99 down ~22% on text-generation workload A (seq len ~256). Token compute cost down ~7% overall. Cache hit rate increased from 28% -> 61% for the canary traffic slice.

kiara: That's huge. Which workloads/clients saw the biggest benefit?

dario: High reuse chat flows and instruction-following workloads where prompts share long repeated system/user prefix. Mobile assistant demos got the biggest tail wins.

leo: Any compatibility risk? e.g. cases where dedup could return stale KV state for streaming?

dario: Good question. We only dedup identical prefix hashes and only within a short time window (configurable). KV entries still keyed by request-id + prefix-hash, so no cross-user leakage. We also disabled dedup for requests with ephemeral user-scoped tokens.

bench-bot: Canary results: 24h window, 5% traffic, env=prod-canary, 95th pct CPU per-GPU -15%, memory unchanged, avg latency -12%. Full report: https://redwood-internal/bench/reports/1865432100

kiara: Nice. How was correctness validated?

dario: Ran 3 eval suites — functional parity (deterministic prompts), sampling divergence checks (KL/attrition), and human eval on 400 samples. No regressions flagged. Also added a regression alert ramp if similarity metrics cross threshold.

ops-bot: Canary deploy completed ✅ — rolled back/auto-fallback guard in place if p99 increases >10% vs baseline.

sahana: Next steps? rollout plan?

dario: We'll ramp 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 72h with automated checks at each step. Tagging eng-sre for watch.

kiara: Any quick config knobs for Dedicated customers? Might be useful to expose dedup-window and allow opt-out per route.

dario: Yup, plan is to expose two route-level flags in the Console: prefix_dedup_enabled (bool) and dedup_ttl_ms (int). Default on for Hosted and Dedicated, opt-out available.

leo: Can we get a short blurb for release notes + notes for sales about expected cost delta per 100M tokens?

dario: I'll draft: "approx 7% token compute cost reduction on reuse-heavy workloads; typical p95 latency improvements 10-20%" and share in #marketing-launch.

sahana: Awesome work. Can we also add a dashboard tile showing dedup hitrate and dedup savings by route?

dario: Already in progress — new panels in Runtime Overview: "Prefix Dedup Hitrate", "Dedup Savings (tokens)" and an alert if hitrate drops >20% vs rolling 7d.

kiara: Congrats team. Any postmortem on cases where it didn't help?

dario: There were a few stateless generation routes with highly unique prefixes — no downside, just no gain. Also saw a small initial jitter with cold KV shards, fixed by prewarming.

leo: Sounds safe. Thanks — please ping eng-oncall for the 25% ramp.

dario: Will do. Patch merged: main@a3f9d — config snippet below for ops if you want to test locally:

```
# enable in runtime config
prefix_dedup:
  enabled: true
  dedup_ttl_ms: 5000
  sample_rate: 1.0
```

kiara: Love it. :rocket:

bench-bot: Note: scheduled full rollout baseline comparison job at 1865510000 for final numbers.

ops-bot: Monitoring alert configured: runtime/prefix_dedup/p99_delta > 10% -> auto-fallback trigger.

sahana: Thanks everyone — would like a short blurb for all-hands tomorrow. dario can you drop 2 slides?

dario: Yep, will drop slides + short demo clip in #all-hands by EOD.

kiara: :clap:

leo: Great work, team.
